## File: android/app/build.gradle
```
apply plugin: 'com.android.application'

android {
    namespace "io.gnucoop.dino.app"


    lint {
        abortOnError false
        checkReleaseBuilds false
    }
    compileSdkVersion rootProject.ext.compileSdkVersion
    defaultConfig {
        applicationId "io.gnucoop.dino.app"
        minSdkVersion rootProject.ext.minSdkVersion
        targetSdkVersion rootProject.ext.targetSdkVersion
        versionCode 1
        versionName "1.0.0"
        testInstrumentationRunner "androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner"
        aaptOptions {
             // Files and dirs to omit from the packaged assets dir, modified to accommodate modern web apps.
             // Default: https://android.googlesource.com/platform/frameworks/base/+/282e181b58cf72b6ca770dc7ca5f91f135444502/tools/aapt/AaptAssets.cpp#61
            ignoreAssetsPattern '!.svn:!.git:!.ds_store:!*.scc:.*:!CVS:!thumbs.db:!picasa.ini:!*~'
        }
    }
    buildTypes {
        release {
            minifyEnabled false
            proguardFiles getDefaultProguardFile('proguard-android.txt'), 'proguard-rules.pro'
        }
    }
}

repositories {
    flatDir{
        dirs '../capacitor-cordova-android-plugins/src/main/libs', 'libs'
    }
}

dependencies {
    implementation fileTree(include: ['*.jar'], dir: 'libs')
    implementation "androidx.appcompat:appcompat:$androidxAppCompatVersion"
    implementation project(':capacitor-android')
    testImplementation "junit:junit:$junitVersion"
    androidTestImplementation "androidx.test.ext:junit:$androidxJunitVersion"
    androidTestImplementation "androidx.test.espresso:espresso-core:$androidxEspressoCoreVersion"
    implementation project(':capacitor-cordova-android-plugins')
}

apply from: 'capacitor.build.gradle'

try {
    def servicesJSON = file('google-services.json')
    if (servicesJSON.text) {
        apply plugin: 'com.google.gms.google-services'
    }
} catch(Exception e) {
    logger.warn("google-services.json not found, google-services plugin not applied. Push Notifications won't work")
}
```

```
#       options in "$@", and eventually passing that to Java.

#       see the in-line comments for details.

#
##############################################################################

# Attempt to set APP_HOME

# Resolve links: $0 may be a link
app_path=$0

# Need this for daisy-chained symlinks.
while
    APP_HOME=${app_path%"${app_path##*/}"}  # leaves a trailing /; empty if no leading path
    [ -h "$app_path" ]
do
    ls=$( ls -ld "$app_path" )
    link=${ls#*' -> '}
    case $link in             #(
      /*)   app_path=$link ;; #(
      *)    app_path=$APP_HOME$link ;;

done

MAX_FD=maximum

warn () {

} >&2

die () {

    echo "$*"

} >&2

msys=false
darwin=false
nonstop=false
case "$( uname )" in                #(
  CYGWIN* )         cygwin=true  ;; #(
  Darwin* )         darwin=true  ;; #(
  MSYS* | MINGW* )  msys=true    ;; #(

if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
else

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."

if ! "$cygwin" && ! "$darwin" && ! "$nonstop" ; then

      '' | soft) :;; #(

        # shellcheck disable=SC3045

    esac
fi

# Collect all arguments for the java command, stacking in reverse order:
#   * args from the command line
#   * the main class name
#   * -classpath
#   * -D...appname settings
#   * --module-path (only if needed)
#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and GRADLE_OPTS environment variables.

# For Cygwin or MSYS, switch paths to Windows format before running java
if "$cygwin" || "$msys" ; then
    APP_HOME=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$APP_HOME" )
    CLASSPATH=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$CLASSPATH" )

    JAVACMD=$( cygpath --unix "$JAVACMD" )

        if
            case $arg in                                #(
              -*)   false ;;                            # don't mess with options #(
              /?*)  t=${arg#/} t=/${t%%/*}              # looks like a POSIX filepath
                    [ -e "$t" ] ;;                      #(

        shift                   # remove old arg
        set -- "$@" "$arg"      # push replacement arg

#     shell script including quotes and variable substitutions, so put them in
#     double quotes to make sure that they get re-expanded; and
#   * put everything else in single quotes, so that it's not re-expanded.

set -- \

        -classpath "$CLASSPATH" \
        org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain \
        "$@"

if ! command -v xargs >/dev/null 2>&1
then

fi

#
# With -n1 it outputs one arg per line, with the quotes and backslashes removed.

# In Bash we could simply go:

eval "set -- $(
        printf '%s\n' "$DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS $JAVA_OPTS $GRADLE_OPTS" |
        xargs -n1 |
```

```batch
goto fail

@rem Setup the command line
```

```scss
dinoapp-forms-map {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;

  #mapContainer {
    overflow: hidden;
    flex-grow: 1;
    height: calc(100vh - 73px);
    min-width: 300px;
    min-height: 300px;
  }
  
  .leaflet-popup-content {
    margin: 7px 10px;
  }
  
  #filtersContainer {
    width: 330px;
    padding-left: 5px;
    display: grid;
    gap: 5px;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    overflow-y: auto;

    mat-form-field {
      height: 50px;
    }

    mat-label {
      font-size: 13px;
    }
  }

  #applyFilters {
    height: 50px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  #applyFilters button {
    display: block;
    width: 67%;
  }

  .mat-mdc-form-field-subscript-wrapper {
    display: none;
  }

  @media only screen and (max-width: 1200px) {
    flex-direction: column-reverse;
    height: calc(100vh - 73px);

    #mapContainer {
      width: 100%;
      height: unset;
    }

    #filtersContainer {
      padding-left: 0;
      padding-bottom: 5px;
      width: 100%;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
    }
  }

  @media only screen and (max-width: 900px) {
    #filtersContainer {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    }
  }

  @media only screen and (max-width: 599px) {
    height: calc(100vh - 65px);

    #filtersContainer {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
  }
}
```

## File: src/app/rag/components/rag.component.html
```html
<div>
  <h1>RAG Document Parser</h1>

  <select (change)="onNamespaceChange($event)">
    <option *ngFor="let n of namespaces" [value]="n">
      {{n === '' ? 'Default' : n}}
    </option>
  </select>
  namespace
  <br>
  <input type="file" accept=".txt,.mp3,.jpg,.jpeg,.png,.pdf,.md" (change)="onFileChange($event)">

  <div class="status-bar">{{statusMessage}}</div>
  <a *ngIf="fileUrl" [href]="fileUrl" target="_blank">{{fileUrl}}</a>
  <span *ngIf="!fileUrl">&nbsp;</span>

  <hr>

  <h2>Supported File Types:</h2>
  <ul>
    <li>TXT documents</li>
    <li>Audio files (MP3)</li>
    <li>Images (JPG, JPEG, PNG)</li>
    <li>PDF documents</li>
    <li>Markdown documents</li>
    <!--<li>Video files (MP4)</li>-->
  </ul>
</div>

<div>
  <h1 *ngIf="files.length > 0">Imported Files</h1>

  <table>
    <tr *ngFor="let file of files">
      <td>
        <a [href]="filesUrl+'/'+file.id" target="_blank">{{file.name}}</a>
      </td>
    </tr>
  </table>

  <br><br><br><br>
</div>
```

```scss
dinoapp-rag {
    display: flex;
    gap: 30px;
    padding: 17px;
    padding-bottom: 40px;

    @media only screen and (max-width: 900px) {
        flex-direction: column;
    }

    div:first-child {
        flex-grow: 1;
    }

    h1 {
        margin-bottom: 20px !important;
    }

    h2 {
        margin-bottom: 13px !important;
    }

    select, select option, input[type=file], input::file-selector-button {
        font-family: inherit;
    }

    select, input::file-selector-button {
        display: inline-block;
        min-width: 120px;
        height: 24px;
        border: 1px solid #444;
        border-radius: 4px;
        margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    select {
        padding-left: 2px;
        margin-right: 1px;
    }

    input::file-selector-button {
        text-align: left;
    }

    .status-bar {
        font-size: 17px;
        margin: 10px 0;
    }

    hr {
        margin-top: 40px;
        margin-bottom: 15px;
    }

    td:first-child {
        max-width: 400px;
    }
}
```

## File: src/custom-themes/_pico.scss
```scss
*:not(.mat-icon) {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif !important;
}

$pico-purple: rgb(98, 91, 171);
$pico-orange: rgb(229, 51, 33);
$pico-hover-background-white: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
$pico-hover-background-grey: rgba(100, 100, 100, 0.3);
$pico-hover-background-purple: rgba(98, 91, 171, 0.2);
$pico-hover-background-purple-light: rgba(98, 91, 171, 0.1);
$pico-hover-background-orange: rgba(229, 51, 33, 0.2);
$pico-white: white;

html,
body {
    .dino-toolbar.dino-shadowed {
        .dino-active-user-icon,
        .dino-active-user-text {
            opacity: 1 !important;
        }
        .dino-active-user-text {
            font-weight: 400 !important;
        }
        .dino-active-user-icon {
            max-width: 18px !important;
            max-height: 18px !important;
        }
    }
    .mat-sidenav.dino-sidenav {
        border-top-right-radius: 15px !important;
        background-color: $pico-purple !important;
        .mat-mdc-list-item-interactive::before {
            background: transparent !important;
        }
        .mat-mdc-nav-list .mat-mdc-list-item {
            font-weight: 400 !important;
            span {
                padding: unset;
            }
            .mat-mdc-list-item-unscoped-content {
                margin-right: 15px !important;
                color: $pico-white !important;
                padding: 0px 16px;
                min-height: 50px;
                .mat-icon{
                    margin-right: 20px;
                }
            }
            &.dino-section-selected,
            &:hover {
                box-shadow: none !important;
                color: $pico-white !important;
                background-color: transparent !important;
                .mat-mdc-list-item-unscoped-content {
                    border-radius: 15px !important;
                    background-color: $pico-hover-background-white !important;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    .dino-grid-list {
        .dino-grid-tile {
            border-radius: 15px !important;
            transition: all ease-in-out 0.5s !important;
            border: none !important;
            font-weight: 600 !important;
            background-color: $pico-hover-background-purple-light !important;
            .dino-grid-icon .dino-mat-icon {
                height: 35px !important;
                width: 35px !important;
                margin: auto !important;
                padding: 20px !important;
                border-radius: 15px !important;
                background-color: $pico-white !important;
            }
            .dino-grid-icon .dino-mat-icon,
            .dino-grid-label {
                transition: all ease-in-out 0.5s !important;
                color: $pico-purple !important;
            }
            &:hover {
                transition: all ease-in-out 0.5s !important;
                box-shadow: 0px 0px 15px 10px $pico-hover-background-grey !important;
                background-color: $pico-orange !important;
                .dino-grid-icon .dino-mat-icon {
                    background-color: $pico-hover-background-white !important;
                }
                .dino-grid-icon .dino-mat-icon,
                .dino-grid-label {
                    transition: all ease-in-out 0.5s !important;
                    color: $pico-white !important;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## File: src/custom-themes/styles.pico.scss
```scss
@use '../typography';
@use './pico';
@use 'angular-material-css-vars' as mat-css-vars with (
  $dark-theme-selector: '.isDarkTheme',
  $light-theme-selector: '.isLightTheme'
);

@include mat-css-vars.init-material-css-vars();
@include typography.all-components-typography();
$mat-css-dark-theme-selector: '.isDarkTheme';
$mat-css-light-theme-selector: '.isLightTheme';

/* You can add global styles to this file, and also import other style files */

html,
body {
  height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
}
body {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;
  .mat-mdc-radio-button {
    background-color: transparent !important;
  }
  .mat-mdc-autocomplete-panel {
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    &::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    }
  }
  ajf-checkbox-group-item {
    .mat-mdc-button {
      background-color: transparent !important;
    }
  }
  .mat-mdc-progress-bar .mdc-linear-progress__buffer-bar {
    background-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(50) !important;
  }
  .mdc-linear-progress__bar.mdc-linear-progress__primary-bar {
    background-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(500) !important;
  }

  ::-webkit-scrollbar {
    max-width: 5px !important;
    max-height: 5px !important;
  }

  ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    border-radius: 5px;
  }

  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-accent(500);
    border-radius: 5px;
    max-width: 20%;
  }
}

.mat-calendar {
  .mat-calendar-body-cell-content {
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .mat-calendar-body-cell::before,
  .mat-calendar-body-cell::after,
  .mat-calendar-body-cell-preview {
    border: none;
  }

  .mat-calendar-table tr td:last-child span,
  .mat-calendar-table tr td:last-child input {
    border-right: none;
  }

  .mat-calendar-table tr:last-of-type td span,
  .mat-calendar-table tr:last-of-type td input {
    border-bottom: none;
  }
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Represents Environment Data settings
 */
export interface DataConfig {
  /**
   * The graphql endpoint url
   */
  syncGraphQLUrl: string;
  /**
   * The graphql websocket url
   */
  wsUrl: string;
  /**
   * Default authentication error message (token expiration)
   */
  authErrorMessage: string;
  /**
   * The error code number the websocket server returns when the Jwt token expires.
   * The Graphql-ws client will not be created without one. (NHost default: 4400)
   */
  socketJwtExpiredCode?: number;
  /**
   * Form Conv service endpoint url
   */
  formconv_post_url: string;
  /**
   * Gnumail service endpoint url.
   * If omitted, the default sendgrid gnumail is used.
   */
  emailSendUrl?: string;
  /**
   * The base url for documentation files bucket
   */
  completionBucketUrl?: string;
  /**
   * The Name identifier of the pouchDb instance
   */
  instanceName: string;
  /**
   * When true, graphql replication happens.
   * Defaults to true.
   */
  live: boolean;
  /**
   * If true, the App will run locally, detached from its backend.
   * No auth is required in this mode.
   */
  backendless: boolean;
  /**
   * If set, determines a fixed duration of the 'Initializing data' screen in milliseconds.
   */
  initializationScreenMaxDuration?: number;
  /**
   * If true, the Backup/Restore panel is available for Admins (default: false)
   */
  backupRestore: boolean;
  /**
   * If true, Dynamic Backend configuration is activated, and the user can choose
   * the Platform to log in to from a select dropdown during login.
   * Those configs must be provided by an external API.
   */
  dynamicBackend: boolean;
  /**
   * The Endpoint from which configuration settings are retrieved
   */
  dynamicBackendapiUrl: string;
}
```

## File: src/_typography.scss
```scss
@use '@angular/material';

// Dino default typography
$base-font-family: "'Roboto', monospace";

$base-typography: material.m2-define-typography-config(
  $font-family: $base-font-family,
  $headline-5: material.m2-define-typography-level(32px, 48px, 700, $base-font-family),
  $headline-6: material.m2-define-typography-level(16px, 24px, 700, $base-font-family),
  $body-1: material.m2-define-typography-level(13px, 22px, 400, $base-font-family),
  $body-2: material.m2-define-typography-level(13px, 22px, 200, $base-font-family),
  $subtitle-1: material.m2-define-typography-level(14px, 22px, 700, $base-font-family),
  $subtitle-2: material.m2-define-typography-level(14px, 22px, 700, $base-font-family),
);

// Components mixins

// Grid
@mixin grid-typography($typography-config: null) {
  .mat-grid-tile.dino-grid-tile {
    div.dino-grid-label {
      font-size: material.m2-font-size($base-typography, subtitle-1);
      font-family: material.m2-font-family($base-typography, subtitle-1);
      font-weight: material.m2-font-weight($base-typography, subtitle-1);
    }
  }
}

// Sidenav
@mixin sidenav-typography($typography-config: null) {
  .mat-drawer-side.mat-sidenav {
    font-family: material.m2-font-family($base-typography, body-1);
    font-size: material.m2-font-size($base-typography, body-1);
    font-weight: material.m2-font-weight($base-typography, body-1);
  }
  .mat-drawer-container.mat-sidenav-container {
    font-family: material.m2-font-family($base-typography, body-1);
    font-size: material.m2-font-size($base-typography, body-1);
    font-weight: material.m2-font-weight($base-typography, body-1);
  }
}

// Text Field
@mixin text-field-typography($typography-config: null) {
  .mdc-text-field,
  .mdc-floating-label {
    font-family: material.m2-font-family($base-typography, body-1);
    font-size: material.m2-font-size($base-typography, body-1);
    font-weight: material.m2-font-weight($base-typography, body-1);
  }
}

// Table
@mixin table-typography($typography-config: null) {
  .mat-mdc-table {
    font-family: material.m2-font-family($base-typography, body-2);
    font-size: material.m2-font-size($base-typography, body-2);
    font-weight: material.m2-font-weight($base-typography, body-2);
  }
}

// Dialog
@mixin dialog-typography($typography-config: null) {
  .mat-mdc-dialog-container {
      font-family: material.m2-font-family($base-typography, body-1);
      font-size: material.m2-font-size($base-typography, body-1);
      font-weight: material.m2-font-weight($base-typography, body-1);
      color: var(--mat-table-row-item-label-text-color, var(--mat-app-on-surface, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.87)));
      h4 {
          font-size: material.m2-font-size($base-typography, subtitle-1);
          font-weight: material.m2-font-weight($base-typography, subtitle-1);
      }
  }
}

// All components mixin
@mixin all-components-typography($typography-config: null) {
  @include grid-typography($typography-config);
  @include sidenav-typography($typography-config);
  @include text-field-typography($typography-config);
  @include table-typography($typography-config);
  @include dialog-typography($typography-config);
}
```

```scss
html,
body {

body {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;
  .mat-mdc-radio-button {
    background-color: transparent !important;
  }
  .mat-mdc-autocomplete-panel {
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    &::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    }
  }
  ajf-checkbox-group-item {
    .mat-mdc-button {
      background-color: transparent !important;
    }
  }
  .mat-mdc-progress-bar .mdc-linear-progress__buffer-bar {
    background-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(50) !important;
  }
  .mdc-linear-progress__bar.mdc-linear-progress__primary-bar {
    background-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(500) !important;
  }

  ::-webkit-scrollbar {
    max-width: 5px !important;
    max-height: 5px !important;
  }

  ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    border-radius: 5px;
  }

  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-accent(500);
    border-radius: 5px;
    max-width: 20%;
  }

  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);

  // UI TOUR STYLES

  // The first anchor element of the UI Tour
  .centered-tour-element {
    position: fixed;
    left: 50%;
    top: 50%;
    height: 0px;
    width: 0px;
    transform: translate(-140px, -78px);
  }

  // UI Tour card popup styles
  .dino-tour-step-popover {
    .mat-mdc-card {
      .mat-mdc-card-title {
        white-space: unset !important;
      }
    }
    &.dino-tour-step-active-popover {
      .mat-mdc-card {
        background-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(100, 0.8);
        animation: pulse 3s infinite;
      }
    }
  }

  // UI Tour Active anchors
  .touranchor--is-active:not(.dino-tour-interactive-anchor) {
    pointer-events: none !important;
    a,
    a .mdc-list-item__content,
    div,
    button,
    form,
    .mat-mdc-form-field div,
    .mat-mdc-form-field input,
    .mat-mdc-form-field label,
    .mat-icon {
      pointer-events: none !important;
    }
  }

  @keyframes pulse {
    0% {
      background-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(100, 0.8);
    }

    50% {
      background-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(100, 0);
    }

    100% {
      background-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(100, 0.8);
    }
  }
}
```

```markdown
# dinoapp 15.2.3

This project was generated with [Angular CLI](https://github.com/angular/angular-cli) version 12.0.2.

## Development server

Run `ng serve` for a dev server. Navigate to `http://localhost:4200/`. The app will automatically reload if you change any of the source files.

## Code scaffolding

Run `ng generate component component-name` to generate a new component. You can also use `ng generate directive|pipe|service|class|guard|interface|enum|module`.

## Build

Run `ng build` to build the project. The build artifacts will be stored in the `dist/` directory.

## Running unit tests

Run `ng test` to execute the unit tests via [Karma](https://karma-runner.github.io).

## Running end-to-end tests

Run `ng e2e` to execute the end-to-end tests via a platform of your choice. To use this command, you need to first add a package that implements end-to-end testing capabilities.

## Further help

To get more help on the Angular CLI use `ng help` or go check out the [Angular CLI Overview and Command Reference](https://angular.io/cli) page.
```

## File: vercel-build-step.sh
```bash
#!/bin/bash

echo "VERCEL_ENV: $VERCEL_ENV"

if [[ "$VERCEL_ENV" == "production" ]] ; then
  # Proceed with the build
  echo "✅ - Build can proceed"
  exit 1;

else
  # Don't build
  echo "🛑 - Build cancelled"
  exit 0;
fi
```
